title: Continuous Ground-Truth Construction and a Recovery Policy for Air--Water Robotic Tracking
abstract: arXiv:2610.11096v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual tracking across the air-water interface is challenged by splashes, bubbles, refraction, reflections, and abrupt appearance changes that can temporarily invalidate observations. This setting poses two coupled difficulties: first, for evaluation, image-only annotation cannot reliably describe the target's physical location during visual blindness; second, for online tracking, corrupted observations can contaminate motion estimates and appearance templates. We address the first difficulty with a construction pipeline that synchronizes camera frames with motion-capture poses, projects known target geometry, corrects underwater projection with a medium-gated residual, and subjects the annotations to manual review. This yields an evaluation-only cross-medium test set of 22,346 frames. We further introduce a Cross-Medium Recovery Policy (CMRP) centered on confidence-triggered template selection. translated_title: 面向空气-水介质机器人跟踪的连续真值构建与恢复策略
translated_abstract: 跨越空气-水界面的视觉跟踪面临飞溅、气泡、折射、反射以及突现外观变化等挑战，这些因素可能导致观测暂时失效。这一场景带来两个相互耦合的难题：其一，在评估方面，仅基于图像的标注无法在视觉盲区期间可靠地描述目标的物理位置；其二，在在线跟踪方面，受损的观测会污染运动估计和外观模板。我们通过一个构建流水线来解决第一个难题：该流水线将相机帧与动作捕捉位姿同步，投影已知的目标几何形状，利用介质门控残差校正水下投影，并对标注进行人工审核，由此得到一个仅用于评估的跨介质测试集，共22,346帧。我们进一步提出了一种以置信度触发的模板选择为核心的跨介质恢复策略（CMRP），它为MixFormerV2提供固定的……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一条结合动捕位姿同步与水下投影校正的连续真值构建流水线（生成22,346帧跨介质评估测试集），并设计了基于置信度触发模板选择的跨介质恢复策略（CMRP），以解决气-水界面视觉跟踪中观测失效带来的评估与跟踪难题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a continuous ground-truth construction pipeline combining motion-capture synchronization and underwater projection correction to create a 22,346-frame cross-medium evaluation test set, and introduces a Cross-Medium Recovery Policy (CMRP) based on confidence-triggered template selection to handle observation failures in air-water visual tracking.
